text:
I understand—late deliveries are frustrating, and I'm sorry yours didn't arrive on time.

**On the delay:** I can offer you a one-time store credit of up to **$15** as goodwill for the late delivery. If you'd like more than that, I can escalate to a Support Lead to discuss further.

**On phone support:** We don't have phone support, but I'm here on chat (8am–8pm Mon–Sat, your local time), or you can email **help@leafy.example** (answered within 1 business day). We also have Plant Care Specialists on chat 9am–5pm Mon–Fri if you need care advice.

Would you like me to apply the $15 credit, or would you prefer I escalate your case?
